verdict.rationale: Agora documents RESTful APIs, so a machine-readable API spec is a fair question, but the probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger file at any candidate path (all returned 404). The llms.txt and markdown docs indexes are machine-readable documentation, not an API specification, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
